facts.fact: Adwave runs its moving company ad mix from one daily budget that starts at $30.
facts.quote: Adwave runs that mix from one daily budget that starts at $30, and it makes the ads from your website.

facts.fact: Adwave pricing runs on a single daily budget ranging from $30 up to $10,000.
facts.quote: [Adwave pricing](https://adwave.com/pricing/) runs on a single daily budget, from $30 up to $10,000.

facts.fact: Adwave has no subscription and no contract.
facts.quote: There’s no subscription and no contract. That budget covers media and ads, along with the work of managing the campaign.

facts.fact: Adwave's daily budget covers media, ads, and the work of managing the campaign.
facts.quote: That budget covers media and ads, along with the work of managing the campaign.

facts.fact: TV, Google (including Search), Facebook and Instagram run from the $30 per day minimum on Adwave.
facts.quote: TV, Google (Search included), Facebook and Instagram run from the $30/day minimum.

facts.fact: Reddit on Adwave requires a daily budget above the $30 minimum.
facts.quote: Reddit needs a daily budget above the $30 minimum.

facts.fact: TikTok on Adwave is live and opt-in from about $91 per day.
facts.quote: TikTok is live and opt-in from about $91/day. You turn it on and connect a TikTok account.

facts.fact: Adwave's planning example of $75 per day for 30 active days totals $2,250.
facts.quote: [$75 a day](https://adwave.com/pricing/) for 30 active days comes to $2,250.

facts.fact: Adwave campaign creative is included in the budget.
facts.quote: Campaign creative is included.

facts.fact: Extra image creation on Adwave costs $0.38 per image beyond the included creative set.
facts.quote: extra creation is priced per item: $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Extra 15-second TV spot creation on Adwave costs $6 per spot.
facts.quote: $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Extra 30-second TV spot creation on Adwave costs $12 per spot.
facts.quote: $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot. Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout

facts.fact: Adwave adds no fee for ACH deposits, while card deposits carry a processing fee shown at checkout.
facts.quote: Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout, and ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: Pausing an Adwave campaign stops future daily charges.
facts.quote: In Adwave, pausing stops future daily charges, and a new daily budget on a live campaign applies the same day if your wallet covers it.

facts.fact: Elromco reports cost per click for moving keywords can exceed $20 in competitive markets.
facts.quote: Elromco’s guide reports that in competitive markets, cost per click for moving keywords can exceed $20, and cost per lead can reach $50 to $80.

facts.fact: moveBuddha says peak moving season runs from May through September.
facts.quote: [moveBuddha’s peak season guide](https://www.movebuddha.com/blog/peak-moving-season/) says peak moving season runs from May through September.

facts.fact: moveBuddha reports 41% of annual U.S. moves happen between May and August.
facts.quote: The busiest stretch falls in summer, and 41% of annual U.S. moves happen between May and August.

facts.fact: moveBuddha advises customers to book local movers four to eight weeks ahead and long-distance movers eight to 12 weeks ahead.
facts.quote: moveBuddha advises customers to book local movers four to eight weeks ahead and long-distance movers eight to 12 weeks ahead.
